summary: Specifies a MIB module for managing multicast over UNI 3.0 and 3.1 ATM networks. It lets network management tools monitor the multicast address resolution parts of ATM. It is a proposed standard and replaces RFC 2366.

eli5.summary: This is a list of dials and gauges for checking on multicast traffic in an old type of network called ATM, so people can watch it from a management tool.
